increment_paragraph: **CONTRACT-LOCKS** (refactoring round 1, pluggable-cards seam A, user decision 1 of 2026-10-24; [report](../../reports/contract-locks/README.md)). Contract pins are generated data instead of literal test tables. Each of the eleven load-path crates keeps a canonical `contract-inventory.lock` (per module: SHA-256, `extern fn` declarations in source order with elaborated clause counts and per-file totals, `contract inherit` edges as written, the premise manifest and binding pins; per crate: the resource, bounds and outer views), written by `providers/contracts.py sync` through a new probe (`cargo run -p qcore-contract --example contract_inventory`) and compared byte for byte by `check`; the `quirin-audit pin` locks are untouched. `compiler/tests/qcore_contract_corpus.rs` drops `EXPECTED_CONTRACTS`, `EXPECTED_INHERITANCE`, the module count and the premised count (2,829 lines to 621) and reads the locks, and a new test recomputes every lock from the tree with its own reading; `providers/tests/test_contract_load_path.py` stops asserting 66 and 17. Every old pin is reproduced: 138 modules, 809 declarations, 7,607 elaborated clauses row for row, 11 inheritance edges, 71 premised `librdkafka/null_deref.qv` declarations, 66 resource-view modules, 17 in libc. Six mutations (a comment-only contract edit, a dropped clause, four lock edits) are each killed by the corpus test and by `check`. Hard invariant 5 and rule 18 now say that a contract change commits its regenerated lock, reviewed as a data diff. No analyzer, contract, verdict or Lean change.
status_paragraph: Contract pins (2026-10-25, CONTRACT-LOCKS): the corpus declaration/clause pins live in eleven generated `providers/*/contract-inventory.lock` files read by `compiler/tests/qcore_contract_corpus.rs`, not in literal tables; the counts are unchanged at 138 modules, 809 declarations, 7,607 elaborated clauses and 11 inheritance edges.

The tree-equals-lock check itself is also in the standing gate through compiler/tests/qcore_contract_corpus.rs, byte form included; providers/contracts.py check is likewise run by no gate step.
